title: odd-menu
description: A menu button (APG): a button that opens a menu of actions, with groups, separators, and submenus. Items come from `<option value>` (the value is the item's `id`), `<optgroup label>`, and `<hr>` children, or from `items`. With `context`, it is also the context menu of another element.
$comment: Slots: default. A child names a slot with "slot"; text and children without "slot" go to the default slot.

label.description: Names the trigger when it shows only a glyph or icon.

appearance.description: The trigger's emphasis, as on odd-button.

size.description: The trigger's size, as on odd-button.

context.description: The ID of an element, in the same document or shadow root, whose context menu it also is: a right-click or long press on it opens the menu at the pointer, and Shift+F10 or the Menu key while focus is in it opens the menu beside the focused element. The browser keeps its own menu while the trigger is disabled.
